review_kind: Separate Codex agent arithmetic and graph semantic review of saved artifacts; not external replication
constraints_reviewed: frequency upper bound and active-line linking

comparison.reference_optimal_status_scope: Recorded optimal status is for the restricted path-based model, not unrestricted passenger paths

figure_data.provenance: Coordinates, stations and all edges from the pinned tiny input; lines and highlighted passenger path from saved final witness
drawing_notes: Use actual x/y coordinates, possibly invert y consistently for the display.

limitations: No optimization solver, official evaluator or official checker was executed.
A separate Codex review is an internal artifact audit, not an independent outside replication.
The arithmetic establishes feasibility and the saved objective, not global optimality of the candidate.
Reconstruction establishes the current pinned reference source shortlist, not a retained execution trace of its path pool.
Exclusion identifies a concrete model restriction that rules out the saved candidate witness; it does not quantify the isolated causal effect of relaxing only that restriction.
No large instance, campaign rerun or live Trackinizer access was performed.

The benchmark formulation file prints an unweighted objective, while problem description, global lambda, reference and checker consistently implement the weighted objective; this audit uses the released weighted contract.
line_index is implementation-specific; physical mode, node and edge paths are checked independently of that label.
